integrity: The infinite statement is proved algebraically from exact common-neighbor counts and a coefficientwise triangular recurrence. Exhaustive finite enumeration is used only as a stress test, and the stronger singleton-inclusive statement is explicitly left unproved.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes every multipartition class has size at least two. Singleton parts are excluded because the triangular coefficient inversion does not determine the singleton coefficient directly. No statement is made about arbitrary graphs or complete multipartite graphs with singleton parts.
title: Co-degree reconstruction of complete multipartite graphs without singleton parts
